company: First Light | Anthem Biosciences, Itc, Mahanagar Gas, Prince Pipes & Fittings, Shanti Gold, Thangamayil Jewellery
headline: First Light | Anthem Biosciences, Itc, Mahanagar Gas, Prince Pipes & Fittings, Shanti Gold, Thangamayil Jewellery

highlights: EBITDA Margin reported 570 bps above our estimate of 45.7% ▪ Commercialized molecules increased ▪ We revise EPS upwards.
MAHANAGAR GAS ▪ Revenue rose 23.8% YoY, driven by 7% volume growth and 16% higher realisation.
Higher gas costs more than offset this, so EBITDA fell YoY ▪ We expect volume growth to stay healthy, led by CNG and PNG.
The recovery in EBITDA spread depends on LNG prices normalizing ▪ Maintain BUY; considering subdued EBITDA performance, we revise TP downwards to Rs1,234 from Rs1,314 Click here for the full report.
valuation: SHANTI GOLD ▪ Revenue grew sharply by 73.5% YoY to Rs 746 crore in Q2FY27, aided by volume expansion of 25.4% YoY to 535.5 kg ▪ Q2 EBITDA margin fell to 5.7% (from 8.55% YoY and 9.97% QoQ) on upfront expansion costs, new product launches and mix. ▪ Management targets 75-80% utilisation over the coming years and sees long- term potential of a Rs 10,000-20,000cr business.
Valuation - On our revised numbers, we arrive at a Sales/EBITDA/PAT CAGR of 19%/23%/23%, respectively.
FMCG growth was led by strong performance across multiple categories, while digital-first and organic products continued to scale, with annualised revenue exceeding Rs18bn.
watch: FMCG- Others remained the key growth driver, with revenue/PBIT rising 16%/28% YoY, led by broad-based growth across Foods, Homecare and Personal Care, alongside 50bps margin expansion.
The Paper business benefited from improved demand and pricing actions, although elevated wood costs and import competition remain key monitorables.
